annotation_method: Manual visual review of all 198 six-second window center frames before model rankings. Labels refer to visible center-frame content, not exact event boundaries or audio correctness.
scope: One user-selected travel video; exploratory bilingual retrieval, not held-out acceptance. Native AV profiles receive video and audio only; annotation text is never model input.
